title: Prompt Catch-Up Credit on the RentGuard Renters Policy
content:
### Condition: prompt catch-up credit

A RentGuard Renters Policy catch-up paid soon after a returned renters payment earns a prompt credit.

Prompt catch-up credit: when the catch-up is paid no more than the tier's late-fee grace period — 10 calendar days on every RentGuard tier — after the latest returned renters payment was posted and the policy is billed on the monthly EFT plan, 5.00 USD is taken off the catch-up amount; when it is paid within that period and the policy is billed on any other plan, 2.50 USD is taken off; when it is paid later, or no renters payment was ever returned, no prompt credit applies.

The period is counted in calendar days from the posting date of the most recent payment returned unpaid on the renters premium account to the day the catch-up is paid.

| Days from latest return posted to payment | Billing plan | Prompt credit |
|---|---|---|
| 10 or fewer | Monthly EFT plan | 5.00 USD taken off |
| 10 or fewer | Annual, two-pay or monthly card plan | 2.50 USD taken off |
| More than 10 | Any | None |
| No renters payment ever returned | Any | None |

Boundary: a catch-up paid on day 10 after the latest return was posted earns the credit; one paid on day 11 does not.

*Hypothetical case:* a return posted on 3 May and a catch-up paid on 13 May on the monthly card plan — 10 days, so 2.50 USD is taken off; paid on 14 May, no credit.
